description: Search the roster (scheduled shifts) by time window, employee, area, and published/open state. Each record has StartTime/EndTime (unix), StartTimeLocalized, Employee (0 or null when open), OperationalUnit (area), Published, Open, Cost and _DPMetaData with names. Deputy: POST /api/v1/resource/Roster/QUERY.

area_id.description: Only shifts in this area (OperationalUnit id).

from.description: Only shifts starting at or after this time: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 date/datetime (include an offset for local times).

published.description: true = published only; false = drafts only.

start.description: Pagination offset (0-based). Pass the previous page's next_start.

to.description: Only shifts starting at or before this time: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 date/datetime (include an offset for local times).

name: deputy_list_shifts
title: List shifts
